entities.name: Politus
entities.description: Leader of the vedalken on Mirrodin during the siege and Phyrexian takeover.

entities.name: Vedalken
entities.description: Race led by Politus, known for understated communication.

entities.name: Research Spire Eleven
entities.description: Spire Politus offered to any mage who could reclaim it from the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Vy Covalt
entities.description: Associate of Politus, tied to lies and deceit according to Unctus.

entities.name: Trennet
entities.description: Ambitious vedalken mage who volunteered to reclaim the spire.

entities.name: Sarja
entities.description: A Neurok woman and Trennet's rival.

events.summary: Politus seeks volunteers to reclaim Research Spire Eleven, promising its ownership to the successful mage.
events.quote: Politus sought volunteers to reclaim Research Spire Eleven.

events.summary: Trennet volunteers and finds a rival in Sarja.
events.quote: Trennet then discovered he had a human competitor

events.summary: Politus officially starts the contest, sending Trennet and Sarja on their mission.

relations.quote: Politus was the leader of the vedalken on Mirrodin
